about: The phone screens of shot 9, drawn flat at full size (1170 x 2532 px, portrait) with their exact copy, in a neutral black-and-white app style with a charcoal (#1F1F1F) pill button: the source store's colours and logo are NOT used. Composite them in post onto the phone screen of shot 9 (corner-pin to the handset; the screen fills the phone face edge to edge, rounded corners 9% of the screen width, a notch at top centre). Screen changes are hard switches (no slide). Taps: an index fingertip from the lower left presses the button; on press the button darkens 15% for 0.10 s.
